about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am an Instructional Designer working in Learning & Development, with experience in developing digital learning experiences, designing and facilitating training programs, and creating initiatives that support organizational learning culture.

My work involves translating subject matter expertise into structured learning experiences, supporting e-learning delivery, evaluating learning outcomes, and creating engaging digital content to reinforce company values and knowledge retention.
I believe effective learning goes beyond delivering information. It requires thoughtful design, meaningful engagement, and continuous improvement based on feedback and learning data.
